info.title: SSO Core API
info.description: Contract reviewed against the local route handlers. Cookie-authenticated browser APIs, OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE, and signed mobile APIs. No production credentials are included. Browser OAuth navigation must preserve state and PKCE in the relying party; the callback helper is diagnostic only. See /docs for integration guides and limitations.

sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly cookie issued by login or successful challenge polling. Browser clients use same-origin cookies; do not paste into frontend JavaScript.

challengeCookie.name: sso_challenge
challengeCookie.description: Short-lived browser proof issued after password verification. Bound to the challenge ID.

Exports configured RSA public key only. May return an empty keys array. These RSA keys do not verify the current HS256 ID tokens.

Browser navigation endpoint. Validates registered redirect URI and scopes; public clients require PKCE. Creates an AuthSession and redirects to login/consent. state must be random, stored by the client, and verified at callback. Use a new verifier (43–128 chars) per attempt; S256 = base64url(SHA256(verifier)).

post.summary: Exchange code or rotate refresh token
post.description: Accepts JSON and application/x-www-form-urlencoded. authorization_code requires code, redirect_uri and client identity; code_verifier required if PKCE was used. Confidential clients require secret via Basic or body. refresh_token requires refresh_token and matching client credentials; rotates refresh tokens (replace stored values). ID token is returned on authorization_code, not refresh. Authorization codes are single-use.

post.description: Two distinct bodies: {action:"generate",password} requires an authenticated session and correct password; creates 10 codes, shown once, replacing all old codes. {challengeId,code} requires password-step sso_challenge cookie; consumes code exactly once and approves pending challenge. Poll challenge-status afterward to finish login. Five failed recovery attempts per account in 15 minutes trigger 429.
